currentContext.expansion: The annual report contains no capex programme, plant-commissioning schedule or capacity-addition narrative. Expansion is described entirely in terms of footprint and capability: during FY 2025-26 the Company incorporated a wholly owned subsidiary, Greenleaf Eco Infra Private Limited (incorporated on July 8, 2025), which the MD&A identifies as the vehicle for executing EPC, PPP and Operation & Maintenance projects, and which the Company intends to leverage in FY 2026-27 to undertake EPC and O&M work. The Company also lists as expansion levers the successful listing of its equity shares on the NSE EMERGE Platform, which it says has strengthened its financial position, market visibility and credibility and improved its ability to undertake larger and more complex projects, with IPO proceeds expected to augment working capital, support business expansion and enhance execution capabilities. Stated growth direction for FY 2026-27 is to strengthen execution capabilities and expand presence across environmental engineering, fire safety and ESG consulting, alongside a broader intent to strengthen technological capabilities, expand the project portfolio and enhance operational efficiency. No project names, sites, capacities, commissioning dates or rupee capex amounts are disclosed.

risks.risk: Working capital intensity and delays in realisation of receivables
risks.note: Listed by management as a threat, and echoed in the Risk and Concern paragraph as exposure to working capital requirements and delays in customer approvals or payments. The MD&A's ratio commentary attributes the rise in the debtors turnover ratio to an increase in the debtor's credit period, so cash conversion lengthens as the project book grows - a structural constraint for a project-execution business whose IPO proceeds are earmarked partly to augment working capital.

risks.risk: Project execution delays from regulatory approvals, customer dependencies or supply chain disruption
risks.note: Flagged both as a threat and in the Risk and Concern paragraph. Revenue recognition and margin on ETP/STP/ZLD and fire safety contracts depend on site handover, approvals and client-side decisions the Company does not control; the stated mitigation is effective project management and internal controls.

risks.risk: Input cost inflation on fixed-price project margins
risks.note: Management flags fluctuations in raw material, equipment and labour costs affecting project margins, and repeats raw material price fluctuation in the Risk and Concern paragraph. In an EPC-style contracting model, cost escalation between bid and execution compresses margin directly.

risks.risk: Intense competition from established players in environmental engineering and infrastructure
risks.note: Explicitly listed as a threat. As a recently listed SME bidding for larger and more complex projects, the Company competes with larger incumbents, which pressures both win rates and bid pricing.

risks.risk: Dependence on Government policy, environmental regulation and public infrastructure spending
risks.note: Management names changes in Government policies, environmental regulations and statutory requirements, and separately economic slowdown or reduced infrastructure spending impacting project opportunities, as threats. The demand narrative rests on Jal Jeevan Mission, AMRUT and Swachh Bharat Mission allocations and on Pollution Control Board enforcement, so the order pipeline is exposed to budget and enforcement cycles.

risks.risk: Shortage of skilled technical manpower and project execution resources
risks.note: Listed as a threat. Execution capacity in a technical services and engineering business is people-bound; the Company had 148 employees on its rolls as on March 31, 2026 and states it will continue to invest in developing and retaining talent.

risks.risk: Rapid technological change requiring continuous innovation and investment
risks.note: Flagged as a threat. Treatment technologies and monitoring/testing capability must be refreshed to stay competitive, which is a recurring claim on capital for a company that also needs working capital for project growth.

risks.risk: Customer approval and payment cycle dependency
risks.note: The Risk and Concern paragraph explicitly names delays in customer approvals or payments alongside competitive market conditions, tying revenue timing and collections to a customer base weighted towards municipal and industrial buyers.
